title: Shader
summary: Official Derivative glossary page for TouchDesigner shaders, covering Vulkan-era GLSL code, Text DAT shader sources, GLSL TOP and GLSL Material references, shader stages, and the obsolescence of Geometry Shaders.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs to decide whether shader source belongs in a GLSL TOP, GLSL Material, generated Phong/PBR shader output, or a Text DAT.
Treat TouchDesigner shader code as GLSL running on OpenGL in pre-2022 builds and Vulkan in 2022-era and newer builds.
Prefer Vertex Shader, Pixel Shader, or Compute Shader stages; avoid planning new Geometry Shader work because the official page marks them obsolete.
Use Phong MAT or PBR MAT generated shader code as a starting point when adapting surface-lighting behavior into a custom shader.
